title: Add onboard source attribution and latency-signature snippet generator
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Introduce source attribution metadata and an automated latency-signature snippet generator to improve onboarding traceability and produce concise release note fragments for model version rollouts.
body:
Summary: Adds metadata fields and tooling for recording model intake source attribution (uploader, dataset origin, manifest-hash) and a sampled-microprofile generator that emits compact latency/signature snippets used by the changelog automation pipeline. Motivation: onboarding often lacked clear provenance and the release automation team had to handcraft perf blurbs from large telemetry dumps. This PR attaches deterministic source attributes at ingest time and computes a small representative latency signature (p50/p95/p99, warm/cold breakdown, exemplar prompts) that can be embedded into changelog fragments and model profiles.

What this changes (high level):
- Schema: extends OnboardManifest with source_attribution {uploader, source_uri, manifest_hash, ingestion_epoch, tag} and provenance_hint (string).
- Microprofile generator: new service that consumes sampled telemetry (from telemetry-ingest -> sample-batcher) and outputs a normalized latency-signature snippet; snippets are small JSON lines stored in /profiles/snippets/ and referenced by model profile records.
- Release note integration: changelog-assembler now consumes snippets and produces a one-line perf blurb template; includes a minimal example for human review.
- Backwards compatibility: new fields default to null; older manifests continue to work and a filler job backfills manifest_hash when available.
- Tests & CI: unit tests for schema migration, snippet normalization, and a lightweight e2e using a synthetic telemetry fixture.

Commits (summary):
- a1b2c3d: introduce source_attribution fields and migration hooks
- b2c3d4e: implement sampled-microprofile generator and normalization rules
- c3d4e5f: wire snippets into changelog-assembler and add templating example
- d4e5f6a: add unit/e2e tests and fixture data; address linting

Files/areas touched (representative):
- src/onboard/schema.py (add new fields, migration helpers)
- src/onboard/ingest.py (populate source_attribution at upload time)
- tools/microprofile-generator/service.py (new)
- tools/microprofile-generator/normalizer.py (new)
- services/changelog/assembler.py (consume snippets)
- tests/onboard/test_migration.py, tests/microprofile/test_normalizer.py, tests/changelog/test_integration.py
- docs/model-onboard/attrs.md (document new attributes)
- infra/db/migrations/2026_02_18_add_source_attribution.sql

Design notes and heuristics:
- Sampling policy: prefer recent production traffic up to 10k requests per model-version over a rolling 24h window, weight by route traffic so low-traffic models still get representative examples.
- Latency signature buckets: warm vs cold separation by cache-hit heuristics; output p50/p95/p99 and a small exemplar set (3 prompts) that produced each bucket's p95.
- Manifest hash: we compute compact sha256:base16 and persist as manifest_hash; used for quick provenance lookup and cross-referencing in audit exports.
- Privacy: exemplar prompts are redacted if they match configured PII patterns; redaction is pluggable and documented.

Review thread (abbreviated):
- Ethan: "Nice addition for provenance. Two asks: (1) make migration non-blocking for large registries, (2) better error handling when sample stream is empty."
- Priya: "Migration runs as async background job; added a non-blocking flag and a short-circuit if sample stream is empty. See commit d4e5f6a."
- Maya: "Can we ensure changelog snippets have a max char budget? We show them in the Console UI and need truncation."
- Priya: "Added truncation at 1KB and a suffix tag to indicate truncation — tests updated."
- Noah: "Unit tests look good; e2e fixture failed once in CI due to a timing flake."
- Priya: "Fixed the timing flake by switching the fixture to deterministic timestamps and added retry in the e2e harness."
- Final: Approved by Maya and Noah after fixes; Ethan approved with a follow-up to monitor backfill load (linked to ENG-6123).

CI & test summary: initial CI run: failed on e2e (timing flake); subsequent run: all checks pass (unit, lint, mypy, integration-lite). CI artifacts attached: test-log.txt, coverage/report.html.

Backward compatibility & rollout plan:
- Step 1 (0-24h): merge to main behind feature flag (onboard.source_attribution.enabled=false).
- Step 2 (24-72h): enable flag for canary orgs, monitor backfill and snippet generation CPU.
- Step 3 (7 days): enable globally and kick off controlled backfill for manifests older than 6 months with low-priority worker pool (rate-limited to avoid db spike).
- Follow-ups: ENG-5281 will add a backfill progress dashboard and alert on worker queue depth.

Operational concerns raised:
- Sample generation CPU: microprofile generator is CPU-light but can be I/O bound on telemetry reads; added batching and backpressure and a queue depth metric (microprofile.generator.queue_depth).
- Storage growth: snippets serialized are ~1KB each; retention defaults to 90 days and can be shortened per-tenant — configuration added to docs.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged by Priya Nair. Commit message: "Add source attribution and latency-signature snippets for onboarding (ENG-5281, ENG-6123)". Post-merge: feature flag kept off at merge; rollout tracked under ENG-5281.

Notes for release notes: The changelog automation can now auto-produce concise perf blurbs for model onboarding, and all new model uploads will carry a manifest-level source attribution. This helps traceability and reduces manual work when drafting release notes.

If there's any concern about backfill window or retention defaults, I'll follow up with a quick patch to make defaults configurable via the console.
